input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no limitation-of-liability, exclusion-of-damages or aggregate-liability language anywhere: the Warranties section (9) has only mutual authority representations and the Globix carve-out, and the General Provisions (10.1-10.8) cover notices, no joint venture, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement and headings. Searches for \"liability\", \"damages/consequential/indirect\", \"indemnify\", \"in no event/aggregate\" and \"limitation\" returned only agency/partnership and \"including, without limitation\" usages. Both parties are therefore fully exposed at law, which fails the fallback (no mutual cap at all). We insert the shortest fallback-level clause as new Section 10.9 (Section 10 already survives under 10.7): a mutual cap at twelve months' fees paid or payable by the Company, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. We did not volunteer the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, consequential-damages exclusion or the wider carve-out set.

proposal.summary: Insert a mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, so we added a mutual cap at twelve months' fees, our fallback position. Indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and wilful misconduct sit outside the cap.

ops.text: 10.9 Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations, its breach of its confidentiality obligations, its gross negligence and its wilful misconduct.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
